error.message: a non-streaming request for 9000 tokens on a ~1-token prompt needs an estimated ~150s, which does not fit the 89999 ms timeout_ms deadline (max 90000 ms — a platform ceiling: the fronting proxy fails a non-streaming response whose headers take ~100 s). Refused before any GPU work rather than after the deadline: lower max_tokens to about 5399 for this prompt, or set "stream": true — a stream's deadline bounds only the time to first token, so it may run as long as it needs
